evidence.use: internal evidence only; never cited or named on public surfaces
evidence.source: Parker Hannifin, Racor Division: Turbine Series 900FH/1000FH instruction sheet 12960 Rev D
evidence.finding: Stage 1 separation: incoming fuel passes through a centrifuge that spins off large solids and water droplets, which fall to the bottom of the collection bowl. Stage 2: fine droplets coalesce on a conical baffle and the cartridge. Stage 3: the cartridge captures fine contaminants.
evidence.retrieved: 2026-10-14 via web search summary; direct PDF fetch blocked from the build environment

evidence.source: Parker Hannifin, Racor Division: 500FG Turbine Series instruction sheet 15332
evidence.finding: The turbine is fixed: it uses the fuel's own flow to remove large solids and free water by centrifugal force. The figure was corrected to show a static deflector.

decisions.decision: Operator confirmed the TURBOCORE stage-1 mechanism: a turbine deflector centrifuges the fuel. Copy restored to state it. Attach an ELIMFILTERS-controlled document reference before publication (FUEL_CANONICAL_GOVERNANCE.md, claims blocked by default).
Readouts show qualitative states instead of numbers on both figures.
